baselines.notes: CSS from stated ~1:45/100m. Run threshold estimated from a 10k at 5:40/km (upper Z3); Garmin now supplies threshold pace + HR. FTP from the first FTP test.

body.note: Cut during the low-volume Dec–Jan block, then eat to fuel training from the ramp.

low_frequency.note: Dec + Jan: max 4 training days a week (busy social stretch). Doubles on Mon/Tue (days off work). Full plan from Mon 25 Jan.

blocked_dates_note: Add trips / exam weeks here as {"from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD", "mode": "off" | "run_only" | "no_pool", "label": "..."}. The plan reshapes around them.
volume_note: Hours are swim/bike/run only. Strength (2 × 40–45 min through Feb, then 1 × 30 min) is on top.
